journal.title: A tiny good moment
journal.text: Hari ini aku menyadari bahwa momen kecil juga bisa membuat hari terasa lebih baik.

journal.title: A quiet afternoon
journal.text: Simpan cerita sederhana di sini. Kamu bisa menulis apa pun yang ingin kamu ingat.

quotes: You don't have to have it all figured out today.
Take it one moment at a time.
Your feelings are worth listening to.
A soft day is still a good day.
